reponse:
The production cutover is Saturday December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC. [2]

That is the current window on KES-398, which Noa marked as the reference because the Notion runbook is not updated yet. Maya approved it on Nov 16. [2] Customer notice (status page and in-app banner) is Saturday Nov 28, with a migration freeze from Thursday Dec 3. [2]

The older Nov 21, 02:00–05:00 UTC window is in the runbook and the Nov 3 Slack announcement. [1][3] It was postponed at the Nov 12 sync, before the Dec 5 date was set. [4]
